# New renderings, iliad-138 (22.1–89)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| κρείουσα γυναικῶν (22.48; feminine of κρείων, here of Laothoe) | "ruling among women" | "a queen among women" | "lady of women", "mistress of women"; the table's κρείων "lord" / "ruling" kept in `l` |
| ὀνομάκλυτος (γέρων ὀνομάκλυτος Ἄλτης, 22.51) | "of famous name" | "a man of famous name" | "renowned" alone, "illustrious"; ὄνομα "name" + κλυτός "famous" |
| λαθικηδέα (μαζόν, 22.83) | "care-forgetting" | "that made you forget your cares" | "care-soothing", "balm-giving", "comforting"; λήθω "make forget" + κῆδος "care" |
| πολύδωρος (ἄλοχος, 22.88) | "of many gifts" | "she of the many gifts" (+ note: dowry or bride-gifts not fixed) | "richly dowered", "rich in dowry" (each decides which gifts) |
| τραπεζῆας θυραωρούς (22.69) | "table-dogs, door-guards" | "my table-dogs and door-guards" | "dogs fed from the table", "watchdogs" (loses the table link) |
| κεραϊζομένους (θαλάμους, 22.63) | "ravaged" | "ravaged" | "plundered" (near ἐξαλαπάξαι "plunder"), "sacked" (ἐκπέρθω) |
| αἰδῶ (αἰδῶ τ’ αἰσχύνωσι, 22.75) | "shame" | "the shame" (+ note says it means the private parts) | "nakedness", "privates"; follows the table's αἰδῶ "shame" (2.262) |
| ἄρηϊ κταμένῳ (22.72; ἄρης "war" as common noun) | "killed in war" | "killed in war" | "slain by Ares", "killed by the war-god" (the edition prints it with a small ἄ) |
| ἀεθλοφόρος (ἵππος, 22.22) | "prize-winning" | "prize-winning" | "racing", "champion"; ἆθλον "prize" + φέρω |
| ἀκέοντο (δίψαν, 22.2; ἀκέομαι "heal") | "healed" | "eased" | "quenched", "slaked"; kept apart from ἀκέων "in silence" |
| ἠΰτε νεβροί (22.1) | "like fawns" | "like fawns" | follows iliad-023 / iliad-132 |
| πραπίδων (ἀπὸ πραπίδων, 22.43) | "midriff" | "heart" | "wits" (kept for ἰδυίῃσι πραπίδεσσι, the craft passages); `l` follows iliad-069 / 081 "midriff", `i` gives the sense of the seat of feeling |
| ὁ γέρων … κόψατο / ἐγεγώνει (22.33–34) | "struck" / "called out" | "struck" / "called out" | "beat", "shouted" |
| πρώτῃσι θύρῃσιν (22.66) | "at the first doors" | "at my front doors" | "gates", "threshold" |
| δηϊοτῆτι (22.64) | "slaughter" | "slaughter" | "carnage", "battle-din"; αἰνός kept "terrible" |
| ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα with δάκρυ χέουσ’ (22.81) | "and to him, a tear shedding, winged words she spoke:" | "and, shedding tears, she spoke winged words to him:" | joins the table's μιν … ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα and iliad-039's "a tear shedding" |

Reused verbatim: 22.14 (iliad-099) and 22.32 (iliad-079). No departure from an Odyssey rendering is made.
